author: cd462127-d3cc-46d4-aa38-5a29afaac7cb
desc: The files app: peer file sharing over WebDAV. Each instance shares runtime/files/shared; the boot control `files` (routed at /files/) hosts the browser UI (your share plus every peer's) and the backend commands: list_dir, get_file, propfind, put_file, make_collection, delete_path, dav_tree, the WebDAV adapter for the local share (dav, /files/dav/) and the adapter that mounts a peer's share over the encrypted peer channel (peerdav, /files/peerdav/<peer uuid>/). Peers read with the files group and write with the files-write group.
